concerns.text: The healthcheck command in docker-compose.yml uses GNU wget options '--no-verbose --spider', which fail in Alpine-based containers; use BusyBox-compatible options 'wget -q -O - http://localhost:8080/health || exit 1' instead.
The PR created a root .gitignore file. According to project directives, root .gitignore should not be created or modified to avoid merge conflicts across parallel feature branches.
In EndToEndDesignSynthesisVerificationTest, SynthesisSession.create relies on system clock rather than an injectable fixed Clock, which could introduce mild non-determinism in timing assertions.
